rule: Smallest K with mean fold RMSE <= minimum mean fold RMSE + SE of RMSE at that minimum AND full-data between-cell mean variance retained >=0.95
objective: Exact contiguous partition of training cell means sorted by mean minimizing sum n_cell*(mean_cell-group_mean)^2
unit: Households, unweighted original-style group estimation; survey-weighted group summaries separate
leakage: Fold training-only cell means, ranks, partitions and group predictions; same cell features map heldout households. Unseen cell fallback training global mean. Demographic labels previously fitted and fixed; CV validates energy compression conditional on those labels, not entire demographic workflow.
standard_errors: Sample SD of five fold RMSEs /sqrt(5); folds are dependent training sets, not population confidence intervals
comparison: K7H/K5E and K9H/K13E DP resolutions are separate from original Tukey membership. Existing original Tukey full-data summaries retained as descriptive comparisons only, never used for fold predictions.
